records.name_as_stated: Bank for International Settlement Investment Pool
records.summary: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas splits its foreign investment securities into internally and externally managed funds, and the BIS runs a named and quantified part of the external side.
records.detail: Note 8 'Investment Securities - Foreign' of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas financial statements for 31 December 2024 splits financial assets at FVRR into an internally managed fund and an externally managed fund. The externally managed fund is itemised as 'Managed funds' of PHP1,460,838,280,412 and 'Bank for international settlements' of PHP102,542,968,069 at 31 December 2024 (PHP96,568,550,349 at 31 December 2023). The narrative under the table adds that externally managed funds include funds managed by external fund managers of PHP1,460.838 billion, the Bank for International Settlement Investment Pool of PHP56.096 billion, and an Asian bond fund of PHP46.446 billion. This meets the test settled at round 68 on the BCEAO BISIP K and Slovakia BISIP CNY precedents: the source names the fund, names its manager and gives a figure. The commercial external fund managers behind the PHP1,460.838 billion are not named anywhere in the statements, so the Philippines remains a disclosure-without-the-firm case for that much larger share; only the BIS part is a tie. The Asian bond fund is named without its manager and is therefore not filed.
records.quote: Externally managed funds include funds managed by external fund managers (PHP1,460.838 billion), Bank for International Settlement Investment Pool (PHP56.096 billion), and Asian bond fund (PHP46.446 billion).
records.source_title: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, Notes to the Financial Statements, 31 December 2024 and 2023, Note 8 'Investment Securities - Foreign'
